_comment: Hand-curated from the MIPS call sites (docs/xena-sfx.md). label: VERIFIED = read from code at the address; INFERRED = meaning/role read from context; UNKNOWN = not resolved. Frames are action-script frame thresholds (actor+0xE6). rand(a,b) is inclusive (func_800B4350).

wrappers.func_80084A34(id): (id, note 60 (64 when (id & 0x3000) == 0x1000), vol 127, pan 64, pos NULL) = 2D
wrappers.func_80084E80(list, n, pos, chance): if rand(0,4095) < chance: entry = list[rand(0,n-1)] (8 B: u32 id, s16 note|priority, s16 vol); vol < 0 -> vol rand(1,127), pan rand(0,127); reroll while the entry is the XA clip already playing
wrappers.func_80084AFC(id, pos): stop: key off every voice of that program (and pos, if given); XA: stop if it is the current clip
wrappers.func_80084CF4(pos): stop every sound attached to pos

playback.vab: D_800CC424[id] = {bank slot, program}; skipped when the slot's bank is not loaded. Tone mode byte set to 4 (reverb) if D_800F1599 else 0. SsVoKeyOn((vabId<<8)|prog, note<<8, 1, 1) keys one voice per tone whose [min,max] contains the note; pitch = SsPitchFromNote(note, 0, center, shift) (44100 Hz * pitch/4096). Then SsUtSetVVol(voice, L, R): SPU voice volume = L*129, R*129 (tone/program/VAB volumes are overwritten). One 32-byte record per SPU voice at D_800F31C8 (24 voices).
playback.volume: func_800844BC(vol, pan, scale, master): v = 0 if scale<=0 or master<=0; v = vol; if scale != 127: v = (scale*vol+64)>>7; if master < 127: v = (master*v+64)>>7; v = min(v,127); L = R = v; if stereo (D_800F1598) and pan != 64: pan < 64 -> R = v*pan>>6, else L = v*(127-pan)>>6. 2D calls: scale 127. Master D_800F1596 = SFX volume option (init 127).
playback.xa: func_8008751C: q = (id & 0xFFF) / 31, channel = (id & 0xFFF) % 31; CdlSetfilter(file 1, channel); read from MEDIA\XA1.XA LBA + D_800CC650[q] (mode 0xC8: double speed, real-time ADPCM, filter). Data sector 31 of the group holds s32 length[31]; playback stops in the data-ready callback when pos (+32 per data sector) >= start + 64 + length[channel] -> 2 + length/32 audio sectors (4032 samples each, 18900 Hz mono). Only one XA clip at a time: a new clip needs priority (note arg) >= the playing one (D_800F366A); bit 0x80 in the note queues it (ring of 8 at D_800F3688..D_800F3748). CD volume: SsSetSerialVol(CD, L, R) with func_800844BC(vol, pan, D_800F3678 scale, master).
playback.voices: 24 SPU voices shared with the music (no reservation found); libsnd allocates them (program/tone priority 255 for every SFX program in the four level-01 banks). Pause (func_80086A24) sets all 24 voices' volume to 0 and resumes them afterwards (func_80086AAC).
playback.reverb: SsUtSetReverbType(3), depth 0x27 (func_80086B68). SFX reverb flag D_800F1599: set at level load to 1 only for levels 8 and 15..18 (func_8006287C 0x80062B28), and by Xena in one map region (func_800367BC 0x80038AFC); level 01: off.

attenuation.function: func_800845C8(pos) -> {vol, pan}; re-evaluated every frame for voices with a position (func_80084FAC)
attenuation.listener: camera D_800F10EC: position +0x1C/+0x20/+0x24 (x,y,z); azimuth = atan(cam+0x44, -cam+0x48) (func_800ADB9C, 65536 units/turn)
attenuation.distance: d = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2) (3D, SquareRoot0) from the camera, not from Xena
attenuation.volume: d <= 2500: 127; else 127 - (d - 2500) * 64 / 10000 (integer), floor 10 (never silent; reached at d = 20781 = 52 m); behind the camera (|relative azimuth| > 90 deg): vol -= vol >> 2
attenuation.pan: rel = atan(dz, dx) - camera azimuth (s16, 65536/turn); behind (|rel| > 0x4000): rel = -0x8000 - rel (mirrored to the front); pan = clamp(64 + ((s16)rel * 64) / D_800F158A, 0, 127) (integer division); D_800F158A = func_800ADB9C(D_800F0732, D_800F072C / 2) set at sound-set load = horizontal half field of view in the same units; mono (D_800F1598 = 0): pan 64
attenuation.finalScale: the call's vol becomes the scale argument: final = func_800844BC(distVol, pan, callVol, master)
